notes.title: Zombie night update
notes.notes: On Halloween night only, the game changes into a Zombie apocallypse, try to stay alive by killing the Zombies that sneak up on you. This update also changes the single player mode to Zombie night. On the multiplayer if you're bitten by a Zombie you become one for the rest of the night even if you restart the game, you must now attack other players so they become Zombies too!

notes.title: Final update for Streatham Hill Stories
notes.notes:
[b]Changes[/b]

-IMPORTANT- There is now a launcher, so single player / multiplayer can be selected from the menu. When the mode is selected it launches the game in a separate window, don't close either window!
- Two new missions, since not many people use online I didn't add any new online modes
- Lots of bug fixes
- Changed all audio from .ogg files to .mp3/.wav files so sounds can be heard on any computer
- Radio stations no longer start from the same point so you will hear different songs 
- Complete rework of keyboard/ mouse controls, old controls can be restored by changing 
keyboard.txt from "1" to "2"
[b]New controls:[/b]
Forward - W
Back - S
Left - A
Right - D
Climb ladder - E
Mouse - Look around/ Pan
Cursor keys - Move camera

Hope you guys enjoy. I am now using the Unreal engine to bring a next-gen Streatham Hill Stories 2, keep a lookout for screenshots soon

notes.title: Last update of 2020
notes.notes:
This update fixes the menu issues and now you are able to save all display settings in the menu. Also a fix during the cutscene where the christmas HUD border is still displayed. 

There will be one last major update in March/April 2021. After that update I will fully devote my time to working on Streatham Hill Stories 2 on the Unreal engine.

March/April 2021 final update:

-Single Player/ Multiplayer selected from menu instead of launcher, faster loading process
-Complete rewrite of vehicle physics system to have realistic driving*
-Complete rewrite of camera system to look more current
-Allow user to choose different button set configuration
-Some sounds aren't heard on some PC's so I will Change WAV's and OGG's to MP3s
-Radio stations will start at a random point instead of always playing from the start
-Of course more missions
-Multiplayer race or graffiti mode (think TAG on Tony Hawks Pro Skater 2)


*If I can't get physics to work any better I will scrap it completely and use a basic moving system, it won't be realistic but traffic lights/ collision detection and speed will be more reliable
